artifacts.summary: Machine-checked CEB's failing half: (Sp) is not a TM-theorem, via a native TaskFrame-free BLFrame semantics, native BL soundness, and the two-fibre countermodel over the disjoint sum Z + R.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added FormalSystem/Semantics/BLFrame.lean (a native, TaskFrame-free BL frame notion with truth, validity and the order-reversal transfer lemma truth_swap) and FormalSystem/Metalogic/Conservativity/SpCountermodel.lean (native BL soundness for TM by recursion on DerivationTree, the two-fibre countermodel over the disjoint sum of Z and R, and the deliverables not_derivable_sp and tmCompleteBase_refuted). Every repository record saying the CEB .Base half was 'not machine-checkable in this tree, and not close' has been corrected. Full lake build green, scripts/check-module-invariants.sh reports ALL CHECKS PASSED, readme-lint and check-metalogic-cycles pass; both new modules are sorry-free and axiom-free with the standard [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] profile.
